basic_info.description: Nestled in a serene cul-de-sac crowning Forest Hill Heights, this unique custom-built home offers panoramic views and abundant natural light with its south-facing design. Featuring 4 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, and stunning vistas from both levels, all in a unique mountaintop setting. The main level is perfect for entertaining with an open floor plan that flows onto a deck offering pano views stretching from the Bay to the ocean. The living room with fireplace has direct access to the deck, while the dining room enjoys pleasant forest views. The spacious eat-in kitchen has a nice outlook and features ample counter and cabinet space.  A guest bath is conveniently located on this level. Upstairs, the split-level design showcases a spacious primary suite with walk-in closet, vanity, & private full bath. Adjacent to the suite is a cozy lounge area with 2nd fireplace. One of the bedrooms has high, sloped ceilings & exposed beams, while two addtl bedrooms have floor-to-ceiling windows & doors. This level also has convenient laundry area and full bath w/double vanity & stall shower. Side-by-side parking in garage. The backyard is extremely private with massive open space spanning the 180 ft. deep lot. Just minutes from West Portal and Inner Sunset shops, Metro lines, and Golden Gate Park.
